verdict_scope: Enabling the proposal as specified; safe default-preserving preparation remains conditional on parent ownership and release
basis: Static design/source counterexamples and primary-source research; no tests or probes executed

findings.title: Freshness bound excludes existing connection writes
static_trace: Qualified authority is loaded and connection is admitted before expiry
Connection pauses or system sleeps past hard expiry without a new load
Process/parent facts, endpoint owners, fingerprints, manifest and generation remain unchanged
Proposed per-write fence omits age and can admit a credential/header or body using the expired tree/group verdict
findings.impact: The finite R1/wake guarantee is not enforced; per-write timeouts do not bound pauses or the entire phase.
findings.required_revision: Immutable qualification lease, absolute sleep-aware expiry checked around async inspection and at every nonempty write; refuse/close after expiry. Define any separately accepted bounded grace.
findings.qualification: Static failure of the advertised new bound, not a runtime reproduction or assertion that current main leaks

findings.title: Endpoint oracle does not attest all native decision fields
static_trace: Return size and endpoint bytes remain valid
A same-size profile/decoding error reads the sharing status from a clear field
False unshared evidence can reach native acceptance
findings.required_revision: Qualified complete ABI/profile and all decision fields; unknown or uncertain profiles use legacy decision. Keep native off/non-authoritative until proved.
findings.qualification: Concrete missing proof/negative-control class; no ABI mutation executed here

findings.title: Native accept does not imply current legacy parser accepts
static_trace: This IPv4 connection is valid, stable and unshared
Another process has an unrelated established IPv6 connection with remote port 8000
No additional local port-8000 listener is needed
Legacy global port-filtered parser rejects the IPv6 record before pair selection
Per-pid native lookup need not see it and may accept the valid pair
findings.required_revision: Legacy-authoritative shadow and explicit treatment of every old refusal class; intentional more-permissive verdict changes require independent review and human acceptance instead of a parity claim.
needed_proof: Production parser as oracle rather than permissive per-pid probe parser
findings.qualification: Static predicate contradiction, not a demonstrated credential leak

findings.title: Refresh token, stale-completion and hung-build semantics conflict
static_trace: Invalidation advances G1 and another build publishes current B
Old completion follows generation-changed eviction clause
B is evicted even though stale completion should be discarded
findings.required_revision: Short-held metadata lock and compare-and-swap key/generation/build tokens; stale success/failure must be no-op. Define hung-work recovery without waiting on its lock, bounded workers and post-await revocation checks. Preserve synchronous non-waiting close and prevent late publication.
needed_proof: No post-revocation bytes or post-close publication
findings.qualification: Contradictory/incomplete state-machine specification, not an executed race

findings.title: D2 recommendation omits native exec-version evidence
findings.required_revision: Separate exec detection from argv-only rewriting; qualify or explicitly reject the private exec-version mechanism before recommending unavoidable R2 acceptance. Retain existing binding for unsupported cases and preserve process_identity tuple.
needed_proof: Supported OS/private API layout and permissions
findings.qualification: Apple upstream source supports investigating the mechanism; deployed Darwin/API compatibility remains unqualified

nonblocking_notes.subject: Clock recommendation supported by primary documentation/source; no local sleep/wake test
Sharing is a sampled reference-count signal, not atomic exclusivity; fallback retains legacy invisible-holder limitations
Full fact-set microbenchmark, end-to-end gains, refresh contention and lifecycle eviction effects unmeasured; no 40ms/global speed qualification
Reconcile 25% versus 50% criteria with the authoritative release protocol before freeze
Default-on P1/P2 and kill-switch behavior cannot substitute for pending human risk acceptance; retain default legacy admission

D1_D4.conditional_options: 30/60/300 seconds only after enforceable lease and publication protocol, explicit human acceptance; W is not a bound on code already loaded during writable exposure
